description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ReviewServiceException' within the 'OrangeHRM\Performance\Exception' namespace. It provides static methods to generate specific error messages related to employee review services in the OrangeHRM performance module.

classes.name: ReviewServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception class, providing static methods for specific error scenarios in the HR performance review service.

methods.name: activateWithoutJobTitle
methods.description: Returns an instance of ReviewServiceException indicating that review activation failed due to missing Job Title with KPI.

methods.name: activateWithoutKPI
methods.description: Returns an instance of ReviewServiceException indicating that review activation failed due to missing KPIs.

methods.name: pastEmployeeForReviewer
methods.description: Returns an instance of ReviewServiceException indicating that a past employee was incorrectly added as a reviewer.

methods.name: invalidSupervisor
methods.description: Provides an exception instance indicating an invalid supervisor was selected for reviewer.
